examples.name: SettingsCard
examples.summary: Field rows inside a flush Card: typed fields sit in a right cell capped at the 3xs container (`field`), and a textarea drops under the copy at the full measure (`stacked`).

examples.name: CompactRows
examples.summary: Login settings: two switches and a Manage button, each at its natural width against the right edge (`compact`).

examples.name: WithMessage
examples.summary: A Name row after Save was pressed with it empty: the input carries its required state and the HelperText message sits under it in the control column.

examples.name: Nested
examples.summary: Protocol rows that depend on a switch above them: HTTPS rows indent one level (`level` 1) and HTTP/3 ports a second level (`level` 2), each behind a rule.

examples.name: WithHint
examples.summary: Cache rows whose description stays one sentence while `hint` carries the longer explanation in a Hint glyph beside the title, reachable on hover or focus.

examples.name: Stackable
examples.summary: A drawer-width card: the Name row keeps its two columns with the description clamped, while the Address row sets `stackable` so its long URL field drops under the copy at full width.
